frame: x right (as you sit), y depth toward the user (0 = back edge of the base / desk), z up (0 = desk); origin back-left-bottom of the base; boxes on the nominal 8 mm grid (real parts 0.1 mm smaller/side); studs (dia 4.8, 1.7 tall) on top of every non-tile part (slopes: high row only; jumper 15573: one centre stud; curved slopes: none); 'slope' {down, high_mm, lip_mm} as in dock/bricks.json, plus curved:true (2/3-high bow, no studs) or inverted:true (the overhang points toward 'down', studs on the whole top); 'section' = base | pockets | dock | necks | frame

sections.base: four 32 x 32 baseplates (taped on the shelf board)
sections.frame: slim screen border on two aluminium bars

steps.1: Not LEGO first: clamp the two VIVO poles to the desk edge, lay the shelf board on the desk 5 mm in front of the clamp plates, stick the four 32 x 32 baseplates on it in a row with double-sided tape (edges touching, studs in line). Plugable box on the desk behind the board.
steps.2: Pocket tray, lower part: brick ribs on the baseplates round the two 13 x 13 pad spaces and their cable channels, then one layer of plates. Drop each Anker pad in (it stands on the baseplate studs), cable out through the channel.
steps.3: Charging floor and walls: three black 8 x 16 tiles over the pads, black tiles on the rest of the pocket floors, plates under the walls, two brick courses of wall, four gold tiles.
steps.4: Two pedestals in front of the poles (three pastel stripe plates each).
steps.5: Not LEGO: VESA plates onto the monitors (stand-offs on the thinner one), hang them on the brackets, set height and level.
steps.6: Frame, lower part: cross plates, two rails with the 48 in aluminium bar between them, the end posts, the post between the screens and the bottom bezel strips.
steps.7: Frame, top: cross plates (three long ones per screen carry the hooks that hang behind the monitor's top edge), two rails with the 36 in bar, top bezel strip.
steps.8: Laptop dock on the desk right of the board: the dock build unchanged (see ../../dock/README.md), including fitting the Newnex plug.
steps.9: Liners and devices: felt in the dock, foam on the hooks, laptop, keyboard, mouse.
